en: Theragāthā 4.7 Catukkanipāta, Paṭhamavagga (The First Chapter) I am one who has abandoned all attachments, I am one who has cut off the stream of craving; Having attained the state of peace, I dwell in the bliss of liberation. The Verses of the Elder Sambhūta:
“He who crosses over when it is time to be slow,
and is slow when it is time to cross over;”
Like the moon in the dark fortnight,
one incurs misfortune and comes into conflict with friends.
He who encourages at the time for encouragement,
and helps cross over when there is need to cross over,
like the moon in the bright fortnight.
and is not at odds with his friends.
